377:t_1:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, it's what you'd call an ultimatum. With this many blunders in a row, even the boss can't just stand by.」

377:t_1:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I've had my share of military achievements! Lord $$バルビエル$$ must know that!」

377:t_1:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's why I'm not saying you'll be executed.」

377:t_1:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then defeat $c. By any means necessary.」

377:t_1:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I wish you the best of luck. I'd be a little lonely without anyone to talk to, after all.」

377:t_1:15.en:
???
「Security at this level means nothing to me.」

377:t_1:17.en:
???
「Heh... First, let me apologize for the discourtesy of entering without permission.」

377:t_1:18.en:
???
「But I will be your emissary of victory.」

377:t_1:26.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「That army of unmanned machines seems to be bothering you.」

377:t_1:28.en:
$$葵$$
「It's irritating to have such a complete mystery running around doing whatever it wants.」

377:t_1:29.en:
$$くらら$$
「According to $$セイミー$$, an autonomous AI has taken control of those machines.」

377:t_1:30.en:
$$朔哉$$
「So that's how they're hijacking machines from all kinds of organizations to build their forces.」

377:t_1:31.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But it seems we're the only ones actually being attacked.」

377:t_1:33.en:
$$葵$$
「In other words, someone with a grudge against us is behind it.」

377:t_1:34.en:
$$朔哉$$
「There are way too many people like that for me to guess.」

377:t_1:35.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「At the very least, there's no doubt they're villains.」

377:t_1:36.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Since $c is, you know, 'the allies of justice!'」

377:t_1:38.en:
$$葵$$
「If something's worrying you, tell us, $$タケル$$.」

377:t_1:39.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「$$葵$$ is right. Keeping it to yourself will only make you more anxious.」

377:t_1:40.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Exactly. We've come this far, so we're in it together. We'll take on any trouble you've got.」

377:t_1:42.en:
$$朔哉$$
「W-What!? Yeah, I don't have a partner to stick with me in sickness and in health!」

377:t_1:43.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Unlike me, $$タケル$$ has $$ロゼ$$! I bet when we're not around, he leans on her and pours his heart out!」

377:t_1:44.en:
$$朔哉$$
「And I bet $$ロゼ$$ tenderly holds him, strokes his head, and lets him rest it in her lap!」

377:t_1:45.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「W-We don't do anything like that!」

377:t_1:48.en:
$$朔哉$$
「See...? It always ends up like this!」

377:t_1:50.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$朔哉$$... I laughed because I was thinking how much we've changed.」

377:t_1:51.en:
$$くらら$$
「That's true. Not long ago, I'd never have imagined us listening to someone's troubles and helping them.」

377:t_1:52.en:
$$葵$$
「But that's how we got stronger. ...Right, $$タケル$$?」

377:t_1:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then I'll follow $$チームＤ$$'s example and let myself rely on everyone.」

377:t_1:55.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「So it is that mysterious robot army that's worrying you?」

377:t_1:56.en:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah... I sense powerful malice through it.」

377:t_1:57.en:
$$タケル$$
「But it's different from ordinary malice or hostility... It's a purer will... something closer to a sense of duty.」

377:t_1:59.en:
$$くらら$$
「...Is it like a soldier ordered to carry out a massacre?」

377:t_1:60.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$くらら$$'s comparison is exactly right. It feels less like the person carrying it out is evil, and more like the act itself is full of malice.」

377:t_1:61.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I'll ask you straight. ...Is it $$ズール$$?」

377:t_1:65.en:
$$タケル$$
「That robot army isn't the only thing making me uneasy... I feel like a colder, darker shadow is closing in around us...」

377:t_1:67.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm sorry. It's only a vague image in my mind too, so that's all I can tell you.」

377:t_1:68.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's enough, $$タケル$$. Just like we promised, we'll share your worries.」

377:t_1:69.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Even if we don't know what that unease means, let's stay on guard.」

377:t_1:70.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「That isn't the only thing we need to watch out for.」

377:t_1:71.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you mean, $$エイーダ$$?」

377:t_1:72.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Danger is closing in on us. Look...」

377:t_1:73.en:
$$谷川$$
「$$ティティ$$! What did you put in the curry!?」

377:t_1:74.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's a secret ingredient. I heard instant coffee makes it taste better.」

377:t_1:75.en:
$$中原$$
「But putting in a whole jar...」

377:t_1:76.en:
$$谷川$$
「It's hardly a SECRET ingredient now!」

377:t_1:77.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's old-fashioned... This is no time to be a wallflower... You have to make yourself stand out.」

377:t_1:78.en:
$$中原$$
「Wait a minute...! Looking closely, this isn't coffee! It's cocoa!」

377:t_1:79.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Well, cocoa is sweeter and tastier.」

377:t_1:80.en:
$$谷川$$
「Spiciness is the heart of curry! If you want something sweet, just drink the cocoa!」

377:t_1:81.en:
$$ティティ$$
「No way, no way. I can't drink a whole jar.」

377:t_1:83.en:
$$大山$$
「I thought we could have her help the domestic staff now that $$エイミー$$ is gone, but it looks like we've got a rough road ahead.」

377:t_1:84.en:
$$入江$$
「We can't send her back to Japan. $c has already reached the $$中央大陸$$.」

377:t_1:85.en:
$$谷川$$
「$n! Take responsibility and do something about her!」
